$comment: Machine-readable crate substitution table for the translator/reviewer roles, synced 2026-10-27 from research/5 section (b) (maintenance dates checked 2026-10-25 via crates.io/lib.rs). One entry per Python name so exact lookup works; 'rust' lists ranked preferences. 'verified' carries per-crate maintenance evidence: an ISO date = last crates.io/lib.rs release/verification check, 'canonical' = well-known stable crate, not re-fetched, 'builtin' = ships with cargo (not a crate); non-crate mappings such as 'serde structs' have no entry. RE-VERIFY before each migration - crate maintenance moves.

substitutions.warning: numpy's full breadth (ufuncs ecosystem, broadcasting ergonomics, np.fft breadth) has no Rust equivalent; numeric/scientific port is a design decision, not a drop-in - port only the used subset
serde replaces pydantic's type coercion (the compiler does it); garde/validator cover value rules via derive macros - Rust needs no runtime type validation
no Rust ORM matches SQLAlchemy's maturity and there is no Alembic-parity migration story; schema-change workflows need a human plan
no FastAPI-native equivalent of auto-generated pydantic OpenAPI docs; utoipa exists
no FastAPI-native equivalent of auto-generated pydantic OpenAPI docs; utoipa exists

NO maintained Celery-wire-protocol-compatible crate exists (rusty-celery stale since 2023-09-25) - broker/protocol lock-in; surface for human decision. Choose apalis/rusty-sidekiq only for green-field queues
bridge crate is pyo3-async-runtimes; the abandoned pyo3-asyncio must not be used
official AWS SDK for Rust (aws-sdk-s3, ...), generated and maintained by AWS; pick the aws-sdk-* crate per service
for registry/plugin-table needs (compile-time-collected runtime registries); true monkey-patching has no equivalent - report back, don't improvise

no_equivalent_zones: Celery-wire-compatible distributed task queues (rusty-celery stale since 2023)
numpy/pandas interactive breadth (polars/ndarray excellent for pipelines; no 1:1 notebook ergonomics)
Python stdlib breadth (email parsing, re behaviors, text encodings) - verify crate-by-crate during translation
scikit-learn / matplotlib (linfa/plotters are far smaller ecosystems - treat ML/plotting ports as high-risk)

pyo3_api_generations.rule: pin one generation per crate; never mix
